pocket-runtime.name: Pocket Runtime
pocket-runtime.summary: The core runtime every Pocket app builds on.
pocket-runtime.description: Pocket Runtime gives legacy devices a shared JavaScript runtime and system bridge that handles app lifecycle, permissions and data sync. Once installed, the device can run the rest of the Pocket ecosystem.

pocket-agent.name: Pocket Agent
pocket-agent.summary: Background service that keeps the device connected to Pocket Studio.
pocket-agent.description: Pocket Agent runs in the background, receives install commands from Pocket Studio, reports device state and keeps the runtime updated. It depends on Pocket Runtime.

openssh.name: OpenSSH
openssh.summary: The standard SSH server and client.
openssh.description: The OpenSSH package from the official Cydia repository. The jailbreak usually installs it already; this entry lets you reinstall or update it. Change the default root and mobile passwords right after installing.

legacy-ca-bundle.name: Legacy CA Bundle
legacy-ca-bundle.summary: Modern root certificates for old systems, fixing HTTPS.
legacy-ca-bundle.description: Most root certificates shipped with iOS 6 have expired, which breaks modern websites. This package adds the current mainstream CA roots so Pocket apps and Cydia can connect over HTTPS.

pocket-reader.name: Pocket Reader
pocket-reader.summary: Offline reader with EPUB and read-later sync.
pocket-reader.description: A reading app tuned for small screens with EPUB, plain text and offline web pages. Installed as an IPA; it does not need a jailbreak but requires a valid signature.

pocket-notes.name: Pocket Notes
pocket-notes.summary: Lightweight notes that sync with Pocket.
pocket-notes.description: A simple Markdown notes app that syncs with other devices through Pocket Runtime. Handy for quick notes on an old device.

pocket-arcade.name: Pocket Arcade
pocket-arcade.summary: A retro game collection packaged for legacy devices.
pocket-arcade.description: Dozens of open-source retro games tuned for the A4 chip and the 3.5-inch screen. Needs Pocket Runtime for save-game sync.

pocket-camera-pro.name: Pocket Camera Pro
pocket-camera-pro.summary: Advanced camera app that needs iOS 7 or later.
pocket-camera-pro.description: A camera app with manual exposure and RAW capture. It relies on camera APIs introduced in iOS 7 and does not support the iPod touch 4. This entry shows how incompatible packages are presented.

tunnel-kit.name: Tunnel Kit
tunnel-kit.description: Connection and tunnel utilities. This local fixture demonstrates app details, compatibility checks, and installation progress.

sensor-tap.name: Sensor Tap
sensor-tap.description: Explore device sensor data. This local fixture demonstrates app details, compatibility checks, and installation progress.

batt-guard.name: Batt Guard
batt-guard.description: Battery status and usage reminders. This local fixture demonstrates app details, compatibility checks, and installation progress.

clip-sync.name: Clip Sync
clip-sync.description: Organize your clipboard across devices. This local fixture demonstrates app details, compatibility checks, and installation progress.

photo-pull.name: Photo Pull
photo-pull.description: Organize photos on your device. This local fixture demonstrates app details, compatibility checks, and installation progress.

font-patch.summary: Adjust text display for small screens
font-patch.description: Adjust text display for small screens. This local fixture demonstrates app details, compatibility checks, and installation progress.
